hardware: Bosch MED17.x gasoline direct injection ECU

flash_memory_map.full_flash: 2MB typical (calibration + OS in flash, adaptations in EEPROM)
flash_memory_map.cal_region: Often 0x10000+ for maps, verify with your dump

checksum.description: Multiple CRC32 regions (poly 0xEDB88320) over map blocks + OS. Correction values patched at end of regions. Public algorithms in tuning community (similar to WinOLS MED17 plugin). Always verify corrected bin with original CS before flash.
reference_files: public example bins from personal dumps only
checksum.routine: Rust implementation planned in checksum.rs extend_edc_med family; current best-effort in multipoint_crc

security_access.reference: security.rs + common public seed/key tables for MED17 (level 1 diagnostic, level 2 extended, level 3 flash/programming)
levels: Level 1: OBD diagnostics / DTC / live data

maps_and_xdf.description: No bundled XDF. Use community addresses or TunerPro/WinOLS to define: Ignition timing (main/spark advance), Fuel (lambda/VE/IQ equiv), Boost (wastegate/target), VVT, Knock control, etc. Typical start: timing ~0x20000-0x30000 range, boost ~0xC0000. Refine per OS ID.

notes: Added in v0.4.0 to expand beyond P01/EDC16. MED17 is very common in modern VW group cars. Protocol: full UDS via CAN in Rust (iso_tp + kwp extensions). Security access uses public known algorithms (extend security.rs with MED17 specific if needed). Checksum: multipoint CRC similar to EDC16. **For personal use only - always bench read your own ECU first, never flash unverified bins.** Use with cheap OBDLink or J2534 interface.
